handle.name: AdapterQuery
handle.doc: Class that contains a snapshot of adapters that are present on the system.

func.name: CreateInstance
func.doc: Creates the {Instance::} with extensions, specified in extension array.

ret.name: instance
ret.doc: points to {Instance::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: debug_layer
arg.doc: defines if the instance is to be created with debug mode.

arg.name: extensions
arg.doc: points to an array of extensions that are to be initialized with pointers to {InstanceExtensionHeader::}.

arg.name: extension_count
arg.doc: counts the number of extensions in the {CreateInstance::extensions} array.

func.name: QueryAdapters
func.doc: Queries all the system adapters and allows to iterate through them.

ret.name: query
ret.doc: points to {AdapterQuery::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: preference
arg.doc: defines the order in which adapters are listed.
